video_title: Wemby has to be like repellent, swatting bugs 🪰 - Chiney says he has to step up in GM 2 | First Take

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama must play with more force in Game 2
quotes.excerpt: He needs to be like the repellent, swatting bugs, being the ultimate deterrent when it comes to the paint.
quotes.quote: Victor Wembanyama needs to go off. He needs to be like the repellent, swatting bugs, being the ultimate deterrent when it comes to the paint because this championship series will be decided in the paint. When you think about the New York Knicks, they actually outscored the Spurs in the paint 50 to 42. That should never happen when Victor Wembanyama is on your squad. He has to play with force, downhill, inside and out, because when he owns the paint, the Spurs cannot be stopped.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama must perform like a superstar in the NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: When you are on this stage, your superstars have to be stars.
quotes.quote: It is going to come down to Victor Wembanyama. When you are on this stage, your superstars have to be stars. We saw that with Jalen Brunson, we saw that with Karl-Anthony Towns. I cannot give Victor Wembanyama a pass. He has to be better offensively. Victor Wembanyama is so much better when he understands that he is a big man first with guard skills. Every time he shoots jump shots, if I am on the other team, I am saying thank you, regardless if he makes them or not. He has to find a way to get going inside of the paint.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: The Spurs struggle when Victor Wembanyama shoots poorly
quotes.excerpt: They are 0 and 5 when he shoots 40 percent or less. They are 11 and 2 when he doesn't.
quotes.quote: They are 0 and 5 when he shoots 40 percent or less. They are 11 and 2 when he doesn't. So we understand the importance of Victor Wembanyama in that regard. You also have to look at the coaching, because you have to put him in a position to make things happen.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: De'Aaron Fox and Jalen Brunson must improve their performance
quotes.excerpt: You can't show up in the NBA Finals and score seven points and shoot three of 13.
quotes.quote: De'Aaron Fox, you are not a rookie. You can't show up in the NBA Finals and score seven points and shoot three of 13 from the field. That's just not going to cut it. Jalen Brunson, you can't wet the bed in the second half after playing lights out in the first half. You have to make sure there is a level of consistency added to your repertoire.

quotes.speaker: Charles Barkley
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns was the key to the Knicks' Game 1 win
quotes.excerpt: The key to the game was Karl-Anthony Towns. He was spectacular.
quotes.quote: The key to the game was Karl-Anthony Towns. He was spectacular. Jalen Brunson is going to get a lot of love because he scored the most points, but if you actually watched that game, the biggest difference in that game was Karl-Anthony Towns, him getting Victor Wembanyama away from the basket, him posting up. If they are going to win this series, he is going to have to be the best player on the court for the Knicks. And he was the best player on the court for the Knicks tonight.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown's defensive strategy on Victor Wembanyama was effective
quotes.excerpt: Mike Brown's strategy was going to be to put Karl-Anthony Towns as the primary and singular defender.
quotes.quote: If you had told me yesterday at this time that the Mike Brown strategy was going to be to put Karl-Anthony Towns as the primary and singular defender on Victor Wembanyama, I would have said, what is he doing? Because not only is that a tough cover, Karl gets in foul trouble. And they can't afford Karl in foul trouble with uncertainty with Mitchell Robinson. Not only did Karl avoid the fouls, and they let the game be played, and that favored the Spurs too, it wasn't just Towns. Karl was able to keep his own man in front of him. Victor couldn't get around him.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson was the best player in Game 1
quotes.excerpt: The best player was still Jalen Brunson because he closed the game in great fashion.
quotes.quote: I agree with Victor Wembanyama and Charles Barkley that Karl-Anthony Towns was the MVP of last night, that doesn't mean he was the best player last night. The best player was still Jalen Brunson because he closed the game in great fashion. You can be the MVP without being the best player.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks successfully took away the Spurs' driving gaps
quotes.excerpt: With the Knicks done, they took away driving gaps.
quotes.quote: I keep preaching about boxes and elbows, and what the Knicks done, they took away driving gaps. And Karl-Anthony Towns, you know what that is called between him and Mike Brown, because you were surprised that he started on Victor Wembanyama? It is called championship synergy. It is trust in that locker room and it is togetherness in that locker room. The fact that Mike Brown and the coaching staff came out and they trusted that Karl-Anthony Towns, his defensive assignment was going to be Victor Wembanyama, straight up. We are not sending any help. We trust you because you have been showing us throughout the playoffs that we could trust you to be our defensive anchor. And he accepted the challenge.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart provides the loose ball intensity the Spurs need
quotes.excerpt: Josh Hart gives loose ball intensity that the Spurs are used to.
quotes.quote: They torched Karl-Anthony Towns last night, I agree. I would just point something out. People said coming into this series that the Spurs were going to give a defensive intensity that the Knicks weren't used to, and there is truth to that, and they struggled a little bit offensively. Josh Hart gives loose ball intensity that the Spurs are used to. You have to be ready for that bowling ball to come down the lane whenever there is a loose ball there, and they are going to learn from having to deal with that.
